name: Zureetha Fargaze
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Zureetha Fargaze watches for threats to young Horde recruits. Alongside Foreman Thazz'ril in Durotar, she sends them to uncover and root out the Burning Blade cult hidden in the valley.

sections.title: Eyes in the Valley
sections.body: Zureetha Fargaze watches for dangers beyond the work and discipline Foreman Thazz'ril oversees. The Burning Blade cult has secretly entered the Valley of Trials, corrupted lesser demons, and gathered strength in the nearby Burning Blade Coven. She sends untested adventurers to recover medallions from the cultists, confirm their presence, and disrupt their early efforts. Then she directs seasoned recruits farther into Durotar.

faq.answer: Zureetha Fargaze watches over the Valley of Trials in Durotar. She stands near Foreman Thazz'ril and looks for hidden threats to the training grounds.

faq.q: Why is she concerned about the Burning Blade?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade cult has taken root in a nearby cave, where it gathers foul familiars and corrupts the peaceful trial grounds. Zureetha sends recruits to recover cultist medallions as proof and thin the cult's ranks.

faq.q: Where does she send recruits after their initial trials?
aliases: where do i go after zureetha
faq.answer: After young orcs and trolls prove themselves against local threats, Zureetha sends them southeast across the ridge to Sen'jin Village to aid the Darkspear tribe.

angles.text: As a young orc taking your first steps into the world, you see in Zureetha the vigilance needed to keep the demonic taint of the past from polluting your new homeland.
As a warlock in the Valley of Trials, you encounter Zureetha's early tasks and face the corrupt vile familiars tied to the Burning Blade's dark summonings.
